cause_quote: The diff added `const chunks = chunkContiguousWork(parts);` and emitted a `kind: "work-group"` for each work chunk in transcript order, so visible narration split the disclosure and post-answer work stayed below the answer.
user_saw: In completed dashboard chats, users saw multiple Worked disclosures between narration messages, with work recorded after the answer shown below it.
summary: The fix restores one Worked disclosure above completed dashboard answers, keeps tool-result images with their tools, and preserves the single activity disclosure in bubble view.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #183267 and confirmed it collected eligible activity from both sides of the final reply into one work group before emitting the answers. The #183267 diff replaced that rollup with order-preserving chunks separated by visible content and removed the bubble-mode bypass, producing the presentation failures described in the fix.
